templates.reminder: Hi {first_name}! Reminder: {services} at {salon} on {date} at {time}. Need to change it? {manage_link}
templates.confirmation: You're all set, {first_name}: {services} at {salon} on {date} at {time}. See you in the chair!
templates.change: Hi {first_name}, your appointment at {salon} is now {date} at {time} ({services}).

templates.reviewRequest: Thanks for coming in, {first_name}! How was your visit at {salon}? Tap to rate it: {review_link}
templates.rebookNudge: Hi {first_name}, it's been {weeks} weeks since your last visit at {salon}. Ready for your next one? {book_link}
templates.waitlistOffer: Hi {first_name}! A time opened up at {salon} for {services}: {openings}. First to book gets it: {waitlist_link}
templates.formRequest: Hi {first_name}, before your {date} visit at {salon}, please fill out: {forms}. It takes a few minutes: {form_link}
